a.lede: Some estimates say hackers stole billions in crypto from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, during a cyberattack on Thursday.
a.title: Binance pauses withdrawals as hackers suspected of stealing billions in crypto

b.lede: A credit card skimming group reportedly compromised a shared analytics script used by e-commerce platform Convertr to steal shoppers' payment data during checkout. [...]
b.title: Hackers hijack Convertr analytics script to steal payment card data
